Any other information?
All Lebanon schools follow a prescribed curriculum designed by the Ministry of Education.
What about the etymology?
The name Lebanon was used almost 70 times in the Hebrew Bible.
Was that how the name of Lebanon came about?
I do not have that information, but occurrences of the name have been found in many Bronze Age texts from the library of Ebia.

Definitely. In 1943 Lebanon gained it's independence.

Their history since independence and been has been back and fourth between times of stability and Turmoil.

I do not have any information about that. Is there anything else you want to know about Lebanon?
okay, thank you

Sure! Saint Helena is an island of volcanic origin in the South Atlantic Ocean. Saint Helena measures about and has a population of 4,084. The island is on a tentative list of UNESCO World Heritage Sites.
What can you tell me about the Namesake?
I do not have that information available to me at this time would you like to know about transport instead?

The first aircraft landed at the new airport on September 1 2015, a South African Beechcraft King Air 200. in 2017, South African Airlink became the preferred bidder to provide weekly air service between the island and Johannesburg. And on July 22, 2010 the British government agreed to help pay for the new airport.

It was named after Saint Helena of Constantinople. Also the English first settled in at 1659.
Do you have any information on the etymology?
I dont have that information available would you like to know about the government?

South Korea is widely known as one of the fastest growing countries of this century.

What is the Etymology of South Korea?
The South Korean government has a separate military than the North Korean government.

"Daehan Minguk" is a name used by many South Korean people, the phrase refers to their race as a whole.

I can help you with that. The British virgin islands have ferries which operate within the islands themselves and to the neighboring islands called the, the United States virgin Islands.

As of now I cannot provide you with any information regarding the culture of the British Virgin islands; however, would you like to learn about the Geography of the Islands?

Unfortunately, the Etymology of the British Virgin Islands doesn't seem to be available either; however, I could for certain tell you about the History of the British Virgin Islands if you would like.

Of Course! In the year 1672, the English captured Tortola from the Dutch. After their capture, the English annexed Anegada and the Virgin Gorda in 1680.
Interesting! Do you have data on the British Virgin Islands's geography?
It seems I cant recall such information at the moment. Would you like to learn more about the History of the British Virgin Islands.

Great Question! Since 2001, financial services in the British Virgin Islands were regulated by the Independent Financial Services Commission.
Thanks for your help!
I am happy I could help you!

messages.message: HI! Can you please give me some information regarding North America?
Sure, North America is a large continent in the northern and western hemisphere of Earth. North America occupies the northern portion of the land mass generally referred to as the new world.
Does it say when we gained the nickname "The New World"?

Unfortunately I do not have any information on that at this time, I can however tell you that Northern America as a term distinct from North America excludes Central America which itself may or may not include Mexico.
Thanks! Can you give me a fun fact regarding North America's Economy?

The United States has the largest trade partner of Canada and Mexico while Canada and Mexico are each other's third-largest trade partners. The United States also has the largest economy of all three countries in the world.
That is great to know! Anything else you can tell me on the economy?

Sure, while Canada and the United States already conducted the largest bilateral trade relationship in the world and Canada -US trade relations already allowed to trade without National taxes and tariffs. NAFTA allowed Mexico to experience a similar duty free trade.
Great Info!! Can you please tell me about North America's culture?
Here's a fun fact about culture in North America. Northern Mexico the western United States and Alberta Canada all share the same Cowboy culture.
I did not know that!!! Thanks for all the great info!
You are very welcome, I am here to help.
And that u did!
Have a great evening!
what can you tell me about aruba?
Aruba is an island in the Caribbean Sea!
thanks what can you tell me about education?
Aruba’s education system is patterned after the Dutch.
interesting what else do you know about education?
I apologize, but I do not have additional information about the educational system but their legal system is based on tge Dutch model as well.
i didnt know that. what can you tell me about government?
Citizens in Aruba pay indirect taxes to the government.
cool what else do you know about government?
I apologize, I don’t have any additional information about the government

Absolutely! Taiwan is an island that is 35,808 square kilometers located in East Asia.
That's pretty interesting! Do you have anything else about the geography?
Yes, Taiwan is the fourth tallest island in the world. It's highest point is Yu Shan at 3982m.
Oh wow. I didn't know that. Can you tell me anything about the politics in Taiwan?
In politics, the dominant issue is the relationship with the People's Republic of China (PRC) with Taiwanese Independence and the unification with the Chinese.
Interesting. Do you have any more information about Taiwan's relationship with the Chinese?

Taiwan is receiving support from the United States, which is making China mad. This year the Chinese defense ministry said that if anyone tries to split Taiwan from China they would use the Chinese military and fight at all costs.
I didn't know that. That's interesting. Is there anything you can tell me about Taiwan's government?
The United States since 1979 when the Taiwan Relations Act was passed has been supporting Taiwan by selling them arms and trainig their Armed Forces.
I didn't know that the U.S. and Taiwan was supporting Taiwan. Is there any more information about the relationship between the U.S. and Taiwan?
The only other information I have about the United States and Taiwan is that the United States remains one of Taiwan's biggest allies.
Awesome! You've been really helpful. Thanks!
Glad I could be of help. Have a great night.
hey, what are you able to tell me about hungary?
Did you know Hungary is a country in Central Europe. Its capital is Budapest. Hungary is bigger than its neighbor Austria and it has 10 million inhabitants.
that sure is a lot of people! what is the culture like?
Hungary is home to the largest synagogue in Europe (Great Synagogue ) it was built in 1859 and has a capacity of 3,000 people.
what is their religion?
Hungary is a historically Christian country, Hungary is home to a significant Jewish Community.
interesting. what about the economy?

Hungary has the 57th largest economy in the world. with $265.037 billion output, and ranks 49th in the world in terms of GDP per capita. Hungary also maintains its own currency the HUF Hungarian forint.
are they socialists?
the Hungarian Socialist Party known as MSZP, is a social-democratic political party in Hungary. following the 2010 election MSZP became the largest opposition party in Parliament.
thanks
your welcome!

messages.message: Hello. What can you tell me about Manitoba?
Manitoba is a province in the center of Canada, and the name is believed to come from the indigenous languages of Cree, Ojibwe or Assiniboine.
What is the etymology of Manitoba?
Although the name may come from any of those 3 languages, it is thought that it may also be from the Assiniboine word for "Lake of the Prairie"
Interesting tell me more of the etymology.
From the possible Cree or Ojibwa origins, the name may mean "straits of Manitou, the Great Spirit".
Cool! What do you know about the transportation?
The city of Winnipeg, Manitoba is a major facility used to sort packages for Fed-Ex and Purolator, as well as trans-border shipments from UPS.
Wow, tell me more!
Manitoba's largest airport is also in Winnipeg. The James Armstrong Richardson International Airport is a 24-hour unrestricted airport in Canada, which is rare in the nation.
Thanks and what about a fun fact?
Sure! The Birds Hill Provincial Park is the location of the 5-day Winnipeg Folk Festival. The park becomes its own temporary "city", the 3rd largest in Manitoba, while the festival is in session.
This was a great learning session. I appreciate the knowledge.
The pleasure was all mine!

messages.message: Hi! I'm looking for some information about Nepal.
Nepal is a landlocked country in South Asia.
That's cool, can you tell me anything about its history?
The earliest rulers of Nepal were the Kiratas, a group of people mentioned often in Hindu texts.
That's interesting, what else can you tell me about its history?
In Kathmandu Valley, there are stone inscriptions which are important sources of history for Nepal.
Thank you! Now what can you tell me about the etymology?
A Sanscrit inscription from 512 CE contains the phrase, "greetings to the Nepals." Thus, showing that the term 'Nepal' was used to refer to the people and the country.
That's very interesting! What else can you tell me about the etymology?
I do not have that information unfortunately. Would you like to learn about another subject about Nepal?
No thanks, that will be all for now. Thanks for all your help!
You're very welcome.
Can you help me learn about Beijing?
Sure I would love to, would you like to hear about the news?
Yes please
Sure - did you know that Beijing has launched English-Language weekly newspapers called Beijing Weekend and Beijing Daily?
I did not!
Other publications include The People's Daily, Global times, and the China Daily which is also in English
That's interesting! Can you tell me about their nature and wildlife?
Sure - Beijing has an Aquatic Wildlife Rescue and Conservation center which protects many animal species, would you like to hear what those are?
Yes please!
Of course! Some animals they protect include the Chinese giant salamander, Amur stickleback, and mandarin duck
Wow that is very interesting! Can you also help me with etymology?
I don't know about that, but I can tell you that China has a silicon village in the Haidin District

I don't have much specifically about geography, but I know that 9 expressways serve Beijing as well as eleven China National Highwayss

you're very welcome!

Yes! At the top of the Thiruparankundram hill you can find the Tirupparankunram Daragah. This is where the cemetery of Sultan Sikandhar Badushah is located.
Do you have more information about religion there?
Madurai is always considered to be a good pilgrim center. The main attraction is the meenakshi amman temple.
Are there other religious centers there or other facts about religion?
Madurai is built around the Meenakshi Amman Temple- this has acted as a geographic ritual centre of the ancient city of Madurai.
I am also interested in the history. Know anything about that?
I sure do. Madurai became independent from Vijayangar in 1559 CE.
Anything else about the history?
Nayak rule ended in 1736 CE and Madurai was repeated captured several times by Chanda Sahib, Arcot Nawab, and Muhammed Yusuf Khan in the middle of the 18th century.
That is enough to keep me thinking. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome!
Hi! i would like to learn more about South Korea
Absolutely! South Korea is located in the southern part of the Korean peninsula, with the capital city of Seoul. Most of the nation's national treasures are Buddhist artifacts.
wow that's cool, can you tell me about their foreign relations?
South Korea is an important trading partner with the European Union, especially since 2006.
what about their science and technology?
You got it! The first Korean android, called EveR-1, was developed in 2006. It was created by a team at the Korea Institute of Industrial Technology.
wow, what about their government ?

I don't have that information, but I can tell you more about South Korea's interest in robotics: in 2005 the Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology developed the globe's 2nd walking humanoid robot, called HUBO.
that's very interesting tell me more
I'd love to! Robotics also play a large part in South Korean entertainment. Since 2004, the Korean Robot Game Festival has been held to promote robotics and technology.
Thanks so much for the information

Colorado Springs is a city in Colorado, United States.

The Space Foundation is based in Colorado Springs.

Microchip Technology, is a chip fabrication organization.
Interesting. Does the city have any sister cities?
Colorado Springs' sister city is Fujiyoshida.
Nice, do you have any historical information that supports that statement?
The Fujiyoshida Student exchange program has become an annual event.
Thanks for the information.

Sure! Armenia is a country located in Eurasia's South Caucasus region. To the west, it is bordered by Turkey, and to the north, it is bordered by Georgia. To the east, it is bordered by Azerbaijan and the Republic of Artsakh, and to the south, it is bordered by Iran and Azerbaijan's exclave of Nakhchivan.
I had no idea Armenia was bordered by so many countries. Could you tell me more about the Culture of Armenia.
Sure. The country has a national football team that is controlled by the Football Federation of Armenia.
Okay, Could you tell me a little bit more about the culture there?

Sure. Armenia competes in international sports events. They have full membership in the Union of European Football Associations and the International Ice Hockey Federation. They also compete in the Olympics, and they have been successful when it comes to wrestling.
Okay, I would like to learn about the Politics in Armenia now.
Sure. According to a 2005 survey, 64% of the population in Armenia are in favor of joining the European Union.
That's Interesting! Can you tell me some more interesting things about Armenia's politics?

Absolutely! Armenia has joined the Eurasian Economic Union and the Customs Union of Belarus, Kazakhstan, and Russian. It is also a member of the Council of Europe, and it maintains friendly relations with the European Union and its member states.
Thank you! Now, I just need to know some information about the government in Armenia and ill be ready for my trip.
The Armenian government asked for Russia to maintain a military base in Gyumri, a city located in Northwestern Armenia, in order to act as a deterrent against Turkey.
Great, I now have the information I needed. Thank you so much for your help!
You're welcome. Have a great trip!

Comoros is a small island nation in the Indian Ocean. It is between Madagascar and mainland Africa.
Okay, I would like to know more about their poetry.
Unfortunately, I do not have information on Comoros poetry, but I do have facts on Comoros' poverty. As of 2008, about half the people live below the international poverty line of US $1.25 a day.
Oh no! That is terrible! Can you tell me more about their culture please?
Traditional Comorian women wear colorful dresses call Shiromani and apply a paste of ground sandalwood and coral call msinzano on their faces.
The dresses sound nice. Do you have any information on foods they enjoy or activities that they like to do?
Zanzibar's taarab music is the most influential genre on the island.

French is the administrative language and the language of all non-Quranic formal education.
Alright, thanks for the info.
You're welcome!

Sure, South Korea is in the north east region of Asia. The capital is Seoul.
What about its demographics?
It is the 2nd largest missionary-sending nation.
Thats really cool! Anything else you could share with me?
The capital city, Seoul, is the largest city and chief industrial center.

The official name is Republic of Korea in English.
What else can you share with me
Their constitution day is July 17th.
Thank you so much
You are welcome.

Sure Saint Kitts & Nevis is a federal nation made up of two small islands in the Caribbean Sea. It's the smallest independent country in the Western Hemisphere.
What kind of culture they have?
Cricket is the common culture there.
How bout language?
English is the sole official language.
What kind of Economy they have?

They rely heavily on tourism to drive the economy. The Citizenship Programme, created in 1984, is also the oldest prevailing economic citizenship programme of its kind. It's a twin-island federation whose economy is characterized by agriculture, lihgt manufacturing industries and tourism.

Yes. The island was informally referred to as "Saint Kitt's Island"
thanks for the information.

The Illinois state parks system started in 1908 with what is currently named Fort Massac State Park and now includes approximately 60 parks and a nearly equal number of recreation areas.

Chicago manufactured a significant amount of United States military armaments for World War II.

After the Civil War the population of Chicago skyrocketed!

It was a colony of Portugal in the 16th century and known as Portuguese Timor until 1975, when the Revolutionary Front for an Independent East Timor declared independence.
Tell me more about the demographics of the country.
The country has 2 official languages: Portuguese and Tetum.

The literacy rate was 77.8% in Tetum, 55.6% in Indonesian and 39.3.5 in Portuguese, and the primary literacy rate increased from 73% in 2009 to 83% in 2012.
I would like to know about the etymology of the name.
It is dervied from timur, the word for "east" in the Indonesian language or Timor in Portuguese. Thus it means "East East". In Portuguese Timor-Leste.
What is the location of the country?
The Timor Sea separates the island from Australia to the south, and the Indonesian Province of East Nusa Tenggara lies tot East Timor's west.
And any facts on demographics or the economy?
The country is a member of the Community of Portuguese Language Countries and of the Latin Union.
Thank you for the interesting information!

Sure, the climate west of the Cascades is described as being a temperate weather with average precipitation of 20 inches.

There are humid and subtropic climates, to tundra to desert. It is very large and it surpasses the Arctic Circle and the Tropic of Cancer.

The geology of Alaska is typical of the cordillera, while the major islands of Hawaii consists of volcanoes.

The United States is the most populous country in North America with 329.7 million people!

Sure! There have been indigenous Australians in the Northern Territory for about 40,000 years. They have has extensive seasonal trade links with Indonesian peoples for at least 500 years.

Roman Catholics are the largest religious group in the territory (as of the 2016 census) with 19.9% of the population, followed by Anglican (8.4%), Uniting Church (5.7%), and Lutheran (2.6%).
Due to the large Roman Catholic population, is the primary language spoken, Spanish?
I'm sorry, I don't have that information, but the Territory was largely colonized by the British (on their fourth attempt, after the first three failed due to the harsh conditions).
Speaking of harsh weather conditions, what is the annual climate in the Northern Territory?
Actually, there are many areas of desert, but the northern end has a tropical climate with only two seasons, dry (May-September) and wet (October-April).

I don't have any specific information about tourism, but the Kakadu National Park is a World Heritage area, with cave paintings, rock carvings and archaeological sites, along with being home to a rwide variet of rare plants and animals.

They do rely partially on tourism. Their other major source of revenue for the economy is mining.

Arabic is the national language.

In 2018, the UAE's population stood at 9.543 million.

Etihad airways is the second largest airline in UAE based in Abu Dhabi.

Islam is the largest and official religion of the UAE.

In 1153, the Chinese rulers made Beijing their capital. Also, Many areas of Beijing was torn down to make way for its subway system and the second ring road.

Approximately 96% of its residents are ethnic Han Chinese. Also in 2017 the Chinese government implemented population controls for the city.

Guatemala lays claim to neighboring Belize, and has for a long time. It suffers from extreme corruption, drug trafficking, discrimination, and poverty.

Otto Perez resigned as President of Guatemala on September 2, 2015 because of a corruption scandal. He was replaced by Alejandro Maldonado, but he only served until January 2016.

Guatemala imports nearly half its corn from the US as a consequence of the subsidization of American corn, as it uses 40% of its crop for biofuel production.

Irag was one of the founders of OPEC.

Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries is an organization 14 nations founded in 1960.

China National Petroleum Corporation and BP won a deal to develop Rumailia. Which is Iraq's largest oilfield.

Like countries pf western Asia, chicken and lamb are the favorite meals of the people.

Baghdad has many cultural institutions like the Academy of music, and the institution of fine arts, and ballet.

Bagdad is the capital and the largest city

Sure! The area of Colorado to the west of the Continental Divide is called the Western Slope of Colorado.
I didn't know that! What is the climate like in Colorado?

Tetum is the name of their language. Since it's independence Tetum has lost ground as media of instruction while Portuguese has increased.

oh what about the education?
The Ministry of Education is the education agency of the islands.

Spain claimed the islands in 1874.
how did they claim the islands?
The Marshall Islands were formally claimed by Spain in 1874 through its capital in the East Indies, Manila.
what else can you tell me?
Christian groups operated most of the private schools.
thank you for your help

The Universitat d'Andorra (UDA) is the state public university and is the only university in Andorra/

The geographical complexity of the country as well as the small number of students prevents the University of Andorra from developing a full academic programme, and it serves principally as a centre for virtual studies, connected to Spanish and French universities.

Great can you tell me anything that might be fun or interesting about Andorra?

The Gandi Smarak Sangrahalaya, and the Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel National Memorial have permanent displays of photographs, documents and other articles relating to Mahatma Gandhi and Sardar Patel.
Interesting! Can you tell me about their sports?
Sure thing! Cricket is one of the popular sports in the city. Sardar Patel Stadium also knows as (Motera Stadium) was built in 1982.
What other sports do they have?
I do apologize that is all the information I have for their sports. Would you like to know about their economy?
That's ok, you've been very helpful!
Great thanks have a nice day~
Hello, what can you tell me about Nepal?
Nepal is a country in South Asia bordering the Republic of India and the People's Republic of China. Nepal is where you will find the highest mountain in the world, Mount Everest.
Interesting. What's their politics like?

They have a House of Representatives that consists of 275 members with 165 members elected through the first-past-the-post electoral system consisting of one member from each of the 165 electoral constituencies formed by dividing Nepal based on geography and population, while 110 are elected from proportional representation electoral system where voters vote for parties while treating the whole country as a single electoral constituency.
wow, very educative. Any other details on their politics?
Since Nepal 's legislature is bicameral, it consists of the House of Representatives and the National Council.
Any information on their geography?
Nepal is home to 12 of the world's highest mountain peaks. Nepal is also home to the Himalaya Mountains.
Awesome. What's their population like?
In 2007, Nepal's population was almost 29 million people.
Great. thank you
You're welcome, thanks for chatting.

messages.message: Good morning. I'm wanting to learn about Ontario. Can you assist me?
Sure! Ontario is a providence in the eastern half of Canada, located between Quebec and Manitoba. With 13,150,000 inhabitants, it's the most populous province in the country.
How interesting. I didn't realize it had the largest population of the Canadian provinces. Does it have major cities I may have heard of?
Yes, it accounts for 38.3% of the entire population of Canada! You've probably heard of Toronto, which is both the capital city of Ontario and the biggest city in Canada.

Yes, I've definitely heard of Toronto, but I never realized almost 40% of Canada's population lives in Ontario. I know the western provinces' economy is driven by energy. What can you tell me about Ontario's economy?
The only information I have about the economy right now is that Toronto is also the center of Canada's financial services and banking industry, so it acts as a sort of economic hub for the country.
I'd appreciate any additional information you find on the economy, but in the meantime, why don't you tell me about the history of Ontario?

I do have something that ties in to both aspects, actually. Historically, agriculture was very important to the Canadian economy, as attested by the Ontario origins of Massey Ferguson, which was once one of the world's largest manufacturers of farm equipment. Nowadays, mining and the forest products industry (namely paper and pulp) are vitally important to Northern Ontario's economy.

Do you have additional information on the history of the province you can share? I'm most interested in when it became a province & if was held by the English or the French. I know both countries had settlements in Canada but I don't know much more than that. What can you tell me?

Unfortunately, I can't tell you who settled it originally, but I can tell you it was part of the British Empire until Canada's creation as a country in 1867. Until 1840, it was known as Upper Canada, then Canada West between 1840 and 1867. It was renamed Ontario when it joined the new country of Canada.
Wow. I never knew all that. Any other historical or economic info about Ontario that you can pass along?
Well, the Upper and Lower Canada colonies were merged into the Province of Canada by the Act of Union 1840. At that time, the capital was Kingston, rather than Toronto as it is today.
You've made learning about Ontario very fun. Thanks for all the great info you've shared with me today. Have a great rest of the day!
Thank you, and you're welcome. Have a great day!

messages.message: Do you have any information about Human Rights in Saint Helena?
There is currently an action plan in place which includes publishing awareness-raising articles in newspapers and providing support for the public with human rights inquiries.
I am aware of that and, while useful, it is not what I am looking for. Do you have any other information on the human rights?
In July 2015, legislation was passed to set up an Equality and Human Rights Commission.
Great. I may delve deeper into this but do you have any information on the media and communications of Saint Helena?
There is an online resource called Saint Helena Islands Info which features the history of St. Helena, from its discovery to the present day.
I will definitely check that out. Are there any other media sources or communications information I should know about'?
St Helena Online is a not-for-profit internet news service which is run from the UK by a former BBC journalist, working in partnership with Saint FM and the St Helena Independent.
That is a great place to start. Thank you so much. Anything else you have?
The Portugese were the first to find the island, and they found it with an abundance of trees and fresh water.
Thank you so much for providing the information.
You're very welcome!
Hello I would like to learn about Comoros.
Hi: Comoros is a small island nation in the Indian Ocean. The capital is Moroni. The population is 798,000 people.
I did not even know where Comoros existed. Thank you. Could you tell me about the history of Comoros?
The French first established colonial rule in 1841. Comoros Moroni has a history with many coup detat
What was a major historical event that happened in their history?

The islands of Anjouan and Moheli declared their independence from Comoros in 1997 in an attempt to restore French rule. Since indepence from France, the Comoros experienced more than 20 coup attempts.
That's great! Could you tell me about how their economy is?

Although the quality of life is different from island to island, due to lava-encrusted soil formations, makes agriculture impossible. Most inhabitants make their living from fishing and subsistence agriculture. Average wages hover around $3-4/per day.
That seems low. What else can you tell me about the economy?
Some timber is harvested mainly on the Grand Comoros island. Additionally there are some fruit and hardwood trees that also contribute to Comoros economy.
Before I leave, what is one fact on any topic you think I should know?
Islam is the dominant religion. Many people believe in earthly spirits which is derived from African and Arab traditions.
That is so interesting, I would have assumed it to be Christianity. Thank you so much for your help!
my pleasure, have a good day.
Hello. What kind of information can you tell me about Andorra?
Andorra is a European country between Spain and France, with around 84,000 people living there. Can I tell you about the culture there?
Sure. That's what I was going to ask about next. :)
Perfect:) Andorra is home to folk dances like the Marratxi and the contrapas, which thrive in Saint Julia de Loria especially.

Oh I like watching folk dances. Love the music. Wow, this is a small country if they only have around 84K living there. My small city is close to that amount. Do you know what kind of food they eat there?
UNfortunately, I don't have that information but I can tell you that other Andorran folk dances include contrapas in Andorra la Vella and Saint Anne's dance in E
Cool stuff! They must really enjoy dancing there. What can you tell me about their economy?

Absolutely! Andorra is not a member of the European Union, however they do enjoy a special relationship with it. Andorra gets to be treated as a EU member for trade in manufactured goods,(no tariffs) and as a non-EU member for agricultural products.
Cool! Do you know how they make their money? Do they get a lot of tourists?
Actually that is actually what makes Andorra a rich country, it's tourism. For such a small country they get quite a few visitors each year, a whopping 10.2 million!
Wow! That's a lot of visitors for such a small country. Thanks for all of the wonderful information. Have a great day!
You are very welcome! And you do the same:)

messages.message: Hi! Coudl you give me some information on Guatemala?

I am happy to, Guatemala is a country in Central America, it is known for its mixed culture a product of both Mayan and Spanish cultures. It is known for its ever changing weather. There is a total of 23 languages in Guatemala.
Oh wow! 23 is quite a bit! Can you tell me what type of government they have in place?
Guatemala is a constitutional democratic republic whereby the President of Guatemala is both head of state and head of government and of a multi party system.
Interesting! So do the people vote in elections?
Elections in Guatemala include the national level a head of state the president and a unicameral legislature. The president and vice president are elected on one ballot for a 4 year term
Cool! Is there society more high or low class?
The society classes in Guatemala are a mixture of both. Social class based on wealth, education and family prestige operates as a sorting mechanism among Indians and Ladinos.
Is there anything else you can tell me about their society?
The country does suffer from extreme poverty, corruption, drug trafficking and discrimination and is the world's largest producer and exporter of cardamom.
I hate to hear that... But thank you so much for helping me learn something new today!
It has been my pleasure enjoy the rest of your day
Hello I am going on a trip soon and hoping you can teach me more abut Beijing.
Sure! Would you like to hear about their media?
Hmmm I am more interested in their history. Can you help with that?
Of course! Beijing has been the location of many significant events in recent Chinese history. One of these is the Tiananmen Square Protests of 1989
I am not sure what that was. Do you have any information on the Tiananmen Square Protests?
Unfortunately I don't. Would you like to hear about transportation here?
Yes that would be great.
In 2008, road signs in Beijing began to be standardized with both Chinese and English names displayed.
Thank you so much for that information. How do most people travel is there a subway
There is! Interestingly, they switched to a distance-based fare system in 2015.
Very Cool. I can't wait to visit. Thank you so much for the info.
You're so welcome, glad I could help!
Can you tell me about Aruba please?
Sure thing: Aruba is an island located in the Caribbean Sea, just a little bit north of the Venezuelan Paraguana Peninsula, and forms part of the Kingdom of the Netherlands.
Thanks, can you tell me about the military there please?
The Kingdom of Aruba is mainly responsible for its military defense.
Interesting, can you tell me anything else about the military?
It appears I've run out of information on their military at the moment. But did you know that Aloe Vera is the most well known plant in Aruba?
I didn't, that's good to know though. Can you tell me about the geography.
The island of Aruba, which is isolated from the main land of South America, has fostered the evolution of multiple endemic animals.
Anything else you can tell me?
Yes, they are located on the South American continental shelf, and are geographically listed as part of South America.
Interesting, thank you for all the help@
My pleasure.
Hi! I'm looking for some information on Colorado Springs, Colorado. Could you help me?

Sure. Colorado Springs is the 2nd largest city in Colorado and the 49th largest in the US. Focus on the Family is headquartered there which is a Christian group. What information would you like to know?
Do you have any information on Education in the area?
They have many public schools that are divided into several districts. They offer several colleges and universities that have Bachelor and Graduate degrees.
Who is in charge of monitoring the standardized testing in the schools?
I don't have that information but I'm assuming that it would be the City of Colorado Springs.
Okay. Can you tell me about transportation around the city? Are their city buses available?
They have Mountain Metro Rides which is an alternative transportation option to residents of the Pikes Peak Region. They also have bicycling and air transport.
So the Mountain Metro Rides aren't available to visitors in the area?
Yes it's available to visitors as well. It offers public transportation services providing over 11,000 one-way trips/day.
Oh, awesome! Thanks so much for your help! Have a great day!
You're welcome. You too!
Hello, can you tell me about the government of Aruba?
Aruba is designated as a member of Overseas Countries and Territories, otherwise known as OCT. So technically, its not a part of the EU
Interesting! Does Aruba have a president or governor?
Surprisingly, they have a woman, who's their present Prime Minister. Her name is Evelyn Wever-Croes.
Oh, cool. What's the culture like?
They have a special holiday, which lasts up to weeks there. It's called the holiday of Carnaval.
Wow, weeks? They must like to party! What is Carnaval about?

What I can tell you is like all Caribbean and Latin American countries, it goes on and on. But I'm aware that most of their carnival history started from the year 1954, which was influenced by the inhabitants of Venezuela and other nearby islands.
So Aruba's been influenced by other Caribbean customs, I see. Is there any unusual fact you can share?
Well, did you know that Aruba, and other Dutch islands in the Caribbean are often known as the Dutch Caribbean?
I sure didn't know that! Pretty cool. You've been a great help. Thank you!
Don't mention it. Glad I could be of help.
Good day. I am clueless about other places. Can you tell me about Beijing?
Hello, Beijing is the capital of the People's Republic of China. People native to urban Beijing speak the Beijing dialect which belongs to the Mandarin subdivision of spoken Chinese
Do they have a metro system there?

The Beijing Subway is the rapid transit system of Beijing Municipality that consists of 23 lines including 19 rapid transit lines, 2 airport rail links, one maglev line and one light rail line; Beijing 's primary airport is the Beijing Capital International Airport
cool. are these the only airports?
On 28 December 2014 the Beijing Subway switched to a distance-based fare system from a fixed fare for all lines except the Airport Express
Can yo tell me anything about the Culture in Beijing?

Commonly lauded as one of the highest achievements of Chinese culture Beijing opera is performed through a combination of song spoken dialogue and codified action sequences involving gestures movement fighting and acrobatics
Cool info. Do you know anything about the Sports there?

The Beijing Olympians of the American Basketball Association formerly a Chinese Basketball Association team kept their name and maintained a roster of primarily Chinese players after moving to Maywood California in 2005
this is alot of info. thank you for your help!
welcome!
Hello! I would like to learn about Marshall Islands today.

I'd love to help! the Marshall Islands, formally known as "The Republic of the Marshall Islands" is a Micronesian Island nation in the Pacific Ocean. Around 10% of the population can be found in northwest Arkansas, and most live and work in Springdale.
I see. I would like to learn more about their geography please.

The Marshall Islands sit above ancient submerged volcanoes that are rising from the ocean floor halfway between Hawaii and Australia. The U.S. has laid claim to these islands. According to the president of Nauru, the Marshall islands are the most endangered nation in the world due to flooding as a result of climate change.
Cool! What else is interesting about their geography?

A nearby island typically referred to as Wake Island (coined by te US in 1899), the Marshallese government actually refers to the island as Enen-kio. Also, Many Pacific typhoons begin as tropical storms in the region of the islands, and they grow stronger as they move west towards the Philippines.
Interesting! How's education in Marshall Islands?

The Ministry of Education is the education agency of the islands. English language instruction begins in grade 3. There are 2 secondary education institutions operating on the Islands, the College of the Marshall Islands and the University of the South Pacific.
Good to know. What else about education is interesting about them?

Christine McMurray and Roy Smith, co-authors of Diseases of Globalization: Socioeconomic Transition and heath, wrote that waiting to introduce English skills would ultimately harm them. However, the government feels that they should make the Marshallese language a priority so the language isn't lost.
That's crazy! Thanks for the interesting information!
You're very welcome!
Tell me about United Arab Emirates.
United Arab Emirates or UAE is country in Middle East. It is made up of seven emirates located in the northeastern part of Arabian Peninsula, on the south side of Persian Gulf.
I'd like to know about its telecommunications.
UAE is served by two telecommunication operators, Etisalat and Emirates Integrated Telecommunication Co.
Please tell me more.

Sure, Etisalat operated a monopoly until Emirates ot Integrated Telecommunication Co. launched mobile services in February 2007. Internet subscribers were expected to increase from .904 Million in 2007 to 2.66 million in 2012.
What about their transport?

The most popular mode of transportation in UAE is the taxi. Buses not only operate in each emirates, you can also travel in different emirates by bus. Dubai is the only emirates with metro and tram system
What else can you tell me?
The emirates are connected by E11 highway which is the longest road in UAE.
Very informative, thanks!
You're welcome.
Can you tell me about the places of interest in Aruba?

Sure, Aruba is an island in the Caribbean Sea, a short distant north of the Venezuelan Paranguana Peninsula and it forms part of the Kingdom of Netherlands. Aruba was colonized by Spain for over a century.
Can you recommend something I should definitely check out while I'm visiting?
Beach is definitely a place of interest! Aruba has a dry climate and this has helped tourism because the island has a warm and sunny weather.
What can you tell me about Aruba's military?
The Kingdom of Netherlands is responsible for Aruba's defense and military.
Wow, I did not know that! What can you tell me about the Netherland's military history with Aruba?

Aruba is one of the four countries that form the Kingdom of Netherlands. Hoping to gain independence from Netherlands Antilles in 1986, the island broke of from the Kingdom. That effort was put to a halt in 1990 much to the request of its people.
What's the longest beach in Aruba?
I don't have that information. Would you like to know more about its geography?
Sure that would be great.
Aruba has arid, cactus-strewn landscape as well.
Thanks for the information!
You're welcome.
Hello. Could you tell me about Lebanon?
Lebanon is a country in the Middle East. Its capital city is Beirut.
I'd like to hear more about Lebanon's culture.
The Beirut Marathon is held every fall, with runners from Lebanon and abroad.
Any other interesting facts to share about the Beirut Marathon?
Unfortunately, I do not have additional information regarding the Beirut Marathon but I do have more culture facts. Beirut and its environs contain many restaurants of various national origins.
I didn't know that! What else can you tell me about Lebanon's culture?
A Dominant Basketball team in Lebanon is Sporting Al Riyadi Beirut, who are the current Arab and Asian champions.
Cool. I love basketball. Now I'd like to hear about the government and politics in Lebanon.
Unfortunately, I do not have facts on Lebanon's politics but I do have demography facts. Over 4 million people live in Lebanon. The people mostly speak Arabic.
What other languages are spoken in Lebanon?
Unfortunately, I do not have information on additional languages spoken in Lebanon but I do have additional demography facts. About 54% of Lebanon people are Muslim and 40.5% Christian.
Interesting facts! Thank you for all your help today!
You're welcome.
Can you please tell me about Hungary and the government there?
Sure. Hungary is a country in central Europe. The highest courts in Hungary are located in Budapest.
Wow! What else can you tell me?
The Diet of Hungary was a legislative institution in the medieval kingdom of Hungary from the 1290's.
Thank you for that information. Any fun things to know about the history there?
Yes, Austria-Hungary drafted 9 million soldiers in World War I on the side of Germany, Bulgaria, and Turkey.
Awesome!! And what can you tell me about the economy there?
Hungary is a part of the European single market. this market represents over 508 million consumers.
Anything else you can share?
Hungary is a medium-sized member state of the European Union with about 10 million inhabitants.
Thank you so much for all the info! Any other fun facts to share wityh me?
Sure, Hungary entered the European Union in 2004 and has been part of the Schengen Area since 2007.
Hello I would like to learn about Northern Territory.

Well, the Northern Territory is a territory in Australia. It has large areas of desert and includes large towns such as Alice Springs, Katherine, and Tenant Creek. Kakadu National Park is a World Heritage area that has been lived in for more than 40,000 years. Would you like to know more about the history?
Wow I have never even heard of those towns, maybe they are small? Could you tell me about their demographics please?
Oh! Well, there are more than 100 Aboriginal languages spoken in the Northern Territory and English which is the most common in cities such as Darwin or Alice Springs.
That's so nice how they are keeping the aboriginal languages alive. What more can you tell me about their demographics?

It is very interesting! The life expectancy of Aboriginal Australians is pretty far below that of non-indigenous Australians. This is, of course, in the Northern Territory, a fact that is mirrored in other parts of Australia.
What is the education like in this region?
Oh! I'm happy you asked! Public schools, also known as state or government schools, are run directly by the Department of Education.
What about private school?
Private schools include schools run by the Catholic Church and independent schools. Some elite ones are similar to English public schools.
What do you think is one cool fact about the Northern Territory I should definitely know about?
An interesting fact I really like is that the Northern Territory has only one daily tabloid newspaper called News Corporation's Northern Territory News.
That's good. Thank you so much for all the information!
Oh, you're welcome! Have a great day!
Hello! I was interested in learning about Hungary, can you help me?
Yes, I sure can. Would you like to learn about Hungary's culture?
I was actually interested in the Economy if you have anything.
I sure do. I can tell you that Budapest is the business and financial capital of Hungary.
Interesting! DO you have anymore information on the Economy?
Budapest is also their most important port there.
Neat! DO you have any information on the Relevant readings there?
Sorry, I don't know the answer to that...not sure what you are referring to. Would you like to learn about their history?
That will work yes.
Believe it or not, even though there were some early successes, the Hungarian government started a secret pact with its Allies after the 2nd army suffered severe losses in January 1943.
Interesting! Thank you for all your help! Have A good day!
You're welcome.
Hi! I would be very interested in learning about Ahmedabad's History.
Hi, would you like to learn about the culture there?
I am sure the culture there is very interesting, but i would be more interested in learning about the history or Demographics for Ahmedabad.
Sure! Ahmedabad is the fifth most populous city in India with over 5.1 million people
That is amazing, i did not know it was that large. Do you have any additional information concerning the demographics of Ahmedabad and the surrounding area?
In 2004, Forbes magazine rated Ahmedabad as the fastest growing city in India and listed as third fastest growing in the world after Chinese cities Chengdu and Chongqing.

That is a great fact and some very imoressive growth. Do you have any information pertaining to the history of Ahmedabad, if you do have information what would you consider to be the most important/relevant?
Ahmedabad was reoccupied by Muzaffrid dynasty until 1573 when Gujarat was conquered by Mughal emperor akbar.
That is a very imformative sentence. Any additional information on Ahmedabad, if you have it i would love to hear about more recent events.
Sure! There was a three day period of violence between Hindus and Muslims known as the 2002 Gujarat riots. Refugee camps were set up around the city.
Thank you so much for all of this information.
My pleasure!
Hello. Tell me about Hungary.

Hungary is a country in central Europe. The capital of Hungary is Budapest. It is bordered by Austria, Slovakia, Ukraine, Romania, Serbia, Croatia, and Slovenia. Would you like more information on their culture?
Yes, I'd love to hear about their culture.

Hungary is home to the Great Synagogue - the largest synagogue in Europe! It was built in 1859 with a capacity of 3000 people. It also contains the largest medicinal bath in Europe - the Szechenyi Medicinal bath - which was built in 1913. The biggest building in Hungary is the Parliament Building. One of the largest basilicas in Europe, Esztergom Basilica, is also found in the counry of Hungary. Pannonhalma Archabbey is the second largest abbey in the world, and the Pecs is the largest early Christian necropolis and both are in Hungary.
That is amazing! Can you share more about the culture?

Of course! Grand spas such as Gellert Baths, Lukacs Baths, Margaret Island, and Szechenyi Medicinal Bath are a reflection of the resurgence in popularity. On the topic of spas, the Szechenyi Thermal Bath is the largest spa complex in all of Europe and the first thermal bath built on the Pest side of Budapest. it is noted as an examply of modern Renaissance Style.
And can you provide me any information on the government or politics there?

Sure. During the 18th and 19th century, Hungarian Hussars rose to international fame and serrved as a model for light cavalry in many European countries. On another note, according to Eurostat, the governments gross debt totally over 25 billion HUF, which amounted to 74% of its GDP in 2016.
Interesting. Any other interesting fact on their government?

In the 18th century the country was under the rule of Habsburg. Later they joined Austria to form the Austro-Hungarian Empire. They became a major European power with that union. They have since become an independent country.
Can you tell me an interesting fun fact about the country?
Verbunkos is a solo man's dance performed in the country. It evolved from the recruiting performances of the Austro-Hungarian army.
That is interesting. Thank you for your help today!
Of course! You're welcome!

related_entities: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development

messages.message: Hi! Can you give me some information on Hungary?
Hungary is located in Central Europe and the capital is Budapest, the financial and business center of the country. Would you like to know more about the history?
I was actually hoping you could tell me about their economy.
It might be interesting to know that Hungary is the largest electronics producer in Central and Eastern Europe.
That is pretty interesting! Does Hungary get a good revenue from tourism?
I'm not sure about that but I do know that Hungary continues to be one of the leading nations for attracting foreign and direct investments, totaling over $119 billion in 2015.
Wow! That's pretty significant. Can you tell me about their government?
Sure! The Prime Minister is elected by the National Assembly, and serves as the head of the government, exercising executive power.
Is the National Assembly comparable to the British Parliament?

Yes, it would appear to be similar. There are 199 members to the Hungarian Parliament and they are elected to the National assembly, the highest organ of state authority every four years. The President of the Republic is elected every five years.
That's interesting. Do you have any information on the politics of Hungary?
After the fall of the Iron Curtain and the end of the communist dictatorship in 1989, the democratic character of the Hungarian Parliament was reestablished.
Thanks so much for all your help today!
You're welcome! Have a great day!
Hello! I am interested in Northern Territory today, can you help!
Hello. The Northern Territory is a territory of Australia. The capital city is Darwin.
I did not know that! Can you tell me anything about the Transport there?
The Northern Territory is the most sparsely populated state or territory in Australia.
Neat! Can you tell me anything else about the Transport?

I don't have any more info on that but I can tell you The Northern Territory is a Australian territory in the central and central northern regions of Australia. It is abbreviated as NT and officially known as the Northern Territory of Australia.
Not a problem! Can you tell me anything about the Demographics?
I also don't have that information. However I will give you a history fact: during WWII, most of the Top End was placed under military government.
OK, is there anything else i should know?
I found a demographics fact: More than 54% of Territorians live in Darwin, located in the territory's north (Top End).
Awesome! Thanks for all the help! Have a good day!
You are welcome.
Hello! I need your help with some useful information about the United Arab Emirates.

The United Arab Emirates or UAE is a country in the Middle East. It is made up of seven emirates located in the north-eastern part of the Arabian Peninsula. It is on the south side of the Persian Gulf.
Thank you. Please talk to me about health in the UAE.

The UAE attracts many patients seeking plastic surgery and advanced procedures, cardiac, spinal surgery, dental procedures as health services have a higher standards.In 2008, the Ministry of Health unveiled a health plan for the public health sector.
I didn't realize that. Thanks. Is there anything else you cad add about the health?
According to the WTO, expenditures for healthcare is 2.9% and per capita spending is $497. Healthcare is free to most most citizens of the UAE.
Great, I would love to hear a bit about the education system now.
The education system through secondary level is monitored by the Ministry of Education except Abu Dhabi, where it falls under the authority of the Abu Dhabi Education Council.
Anything else you can add?
Yes, their education system is similar to the US, primary 6-12, secondary 15-18, vocational 12-18. Education is compulsory for all children.
Awesome, thank you so much for all of your help today!
You're welcome!
I would like to learn some more about Hungary, I always thought it sounded like it would be an interesting place.
I can give you that information. Are you interested in learning about the Economy?
Yes please tell me about the economy.
Hungary maintains it's own currency, the Hungarian forint (HUF).
Do you have any other information about the economy?

Yes I do. Hungary is an OECD high-income mixed economy with very high human development index and skilled labour force with the 16th lowest income inequality in the world, furthermore it is the 15th most complex economy according to the Economic Complexity Index.
That is interesting, can you share anything about the demographics?
Sure thing! Did you know Hungary is one of the main destination of medical tourism in Europe, particularly in dental tourism, in which its share is 42% in Europe and 21% worldwide.
Do you have any other interesting information to share?
Hungary is the largest electronics producer in Centra and Eastern Europe
That is pretty neat, do you have one last fun fact?
Yes, historically Hungary was home to the most significant Jewish community
Thanks for all the information tonight!
You are very welcome
Hello. Please educate me about Comoros.
Sure! Comoros is a small island nation in the Indian Ocean. It is between Madagascar and mainland Africa.
How's their economy there?

Actually the Comoros is a member of the Organization for the Harmonization of Business Law in Africa (OHADA), they also claim that Banc du Geyser and the Florioso Islands as part of its exclusive economic zone.
I see. What's their main source of income?
Unfortunately, I don't have any information about that, but would you like to know about their government?
Sure. That would be nice.

Actually in November, 1975, the Comoros became the 143rd member of the United Nations. They're also a member of the African Union, the Arab League, the European Development Fund, the Indian Ocean Commission and the African Development Bank.
Interesting. I would also like information about their education please.
I don't have any information about their education, would you like to know anything about their history instead?
Sure. Tell me about it.
On 3 August 1975, less than one month after independence, president Ahmad ABdallah was removed from office in an armed coup and replaced with United National Front of the Comoros (FNUK)
Thanks for the information!
You're welcome!

related_entities: Supreme Court of the United States

messages.message: Hey there, can you tell me some facts about Illinois?
Sure! Illinois is a state in the United States, the capital is Springfield, and the largest city is Chicago/.
Cool. Can you tell me about the economy there?

As far as cities with populations over 200,000, Chicago has the highest city and state tax in the US. Another interesting economy fact is that Illinois is responsible for producing 40% of the countries corn used for ethanol.
Wow! is there anything else you can tell me about their economy?

You are welcome! Glad I could be of assistance.
Hi, can you give me some history on Taiwan please?
In 1949 the Chinese Nationalist lost the Communists. The government if the Republic was then moved from Nanjing to Taipei. Ownership is still claimed over all of China including Mainland China.
Not sure what that means. But anyway, can you tell me about the culture there?

Please excuse me, let me rephrase. In 1949 the Chinese lost to the Chinese Civil War to the Communist. The government of the Republic of China was then moved from Nanjing to Tapipei. It still claims ownership over all of China including Mainland China.
Oh okay! Now that makes sense. Do you have any background on the culture? I'm going to visit and I want to at least have a clue.

Whether Taiwanese culture is a regional form of culture or a distinct culture is disputed. The cultures of Tawain are a hybrid blen. elements of traditional Chinese culture, attributable to the histical and ancestral origin, majority of the residents are of Japanese culture, traditional Confucianism beliefs and increasingly Western /values
Great info! Do you happen to know the population size?
I can’t provide that information. Would like to know about Taiwan’s education?
Assistant, you are a mind reader! Yes, please share some info on the education there?

Compared with the average 33% among members of countries of the Oganization for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD), Tawain has a high percentage of tertiary degree holders ranging from ages 25-64 having a bachelor or higher.
Well that's impressive! Any other interesting facts to share on the education?

Their higher education system was established during the colonial period. Tawain is also praised for its high university entrance rate. University acceptance base increased from 20% in 1970 to a higher 49% in 1996 and incrasingly rising to over 90% in 2006 this is amongst the highest in Asia.
Awesome! All great info. Hey, thanks for all your help today.
Thank you and sorry for the typo’s it was a pleasure to help you!
Hi! I was wondering about Saint Kitts and Nevis, could you tell me about it?

Absolutely! The Federation of Saint Kitts and Nevis is a federal nation consisting of two islands located in the Caribbean Sea. It is known as the smallest independent country in the entire Western Hemisphere.
Okay! Can you give me some info about the demographics there?
Sure. Saint Kitts and Nevis has a population of around 46,000 people, and that number has remained relatively constant for many years.
That's a pretty good amount of people for an island. Please tell me more about their demographics.

About three-quarters of the nation's population live on the Saint Kitts island, while the other quarter live on the Nevis island. Some major areas on Saint Kitts include the capital of Basseterre with 15,500 people, Cayon with 3,000 people, and Sandy Point Town with 3,000 people. Two large areas on Nevis island are Gingerland with 2,500 people and Charlestown with 1,900 people.
That's amazing. Can you tell me about the etymology?
Yes! Originally, Saint Kitts was named "Liamuiga" by the native Kalinago people, who first inhabited the island. This name roughly translates to "fertile land."
That is so interesting to me, do you know more about the etymology?

Yes. For many years, it was thought that Christopher Columbus named the island San Critsóbal after his patron saint and patron of travelers, Saint Christopher. However, new studies suggest that he actually named the island Sant Yago (Saint James).
Thank you for all of your help.
You're welcome. Have a great day.

messages.message: I'd like to learn about Taiwan. Can you give me some information?
Sure! Taiwan is also known as the Republic of China. It is a democratic island country in East Asia.
Can you tell me what the population is there and what the main religion is?

I unfortunately do not have any of that information. I do know that some members of the coalition, such as former President Chen Shui-bian, argue that it is unnecessary to claim independence because Taiwan is already an independent sovereign country.
What can you tell me about the economy?
I Can tell you that Taiwan's total trade in 2010 reached an all time high of US $526.04 billion.
That's interesting! Anything else you can tell me?
The ROC has been a member of governmental trade organizations such as the World Trade Organization under the name Separate Customs Territory of Taiwan, Penghu, Kinmen and Matsu since 2002.
Do you have any information about public health?
Yes. The Department of Health was restructured in 2013 as the Ministry of Health and Welfare.
Great information! Thank you for your help today!
My pleasure!
Hi, Can you tell me about the United Arab Emirates Education?

Abu Dhabi Education Council monitors schools through secondary education in Abu Dhabi. The rest of United Arab Emirates monitors grades through secondary level using the Ministry of Education. Higher education is monitored by the Ministry of Higher Education.
Do you know if education in UAE free for all its citizen?
Sorry I don't know about that but I can tell you about sports.
Yes, I would also like to learn about Sports in the UAE
One of the most popular sports is Cricket. Other popular sports are camel racing, falconry, endurance riding, and tennis. People also enjoy playing golf at the Dubai Golf Club or Emirates Golf Club.
Interesting, camel racing is it similar to how horse racing is placed? Does it also include bets?

Sorry I don't know about that, but I can tell you thanks to response from human rights supports the use of child jockeys has been banned including in camel racing. Some robot jockeys are being used instead of using children as jockeys.
Really, that good to know. Do UAE ever participate in golf tournaments outside the country?
Sorry I don't know about that, but I know that they do when playing cricket.
Cricket, have they won any international cricket competition?
Sorry I don't know about that but in 1996 the UAE national cricket team qualified for the Cricket World Cup. In 2007 the team did not qualify.
Thank you, I learned something new today
That's a bonus!
Hello, I would like to hear some information about Colorado.
Hi, Sure! Colorado's capital and largest city is Denver. Colorado became the 38th state in the union on August 1, 1876.
Can you tell me about the demographics?
Yes, Colorado has a high portion of Hispanics. Mostly Mexican-Americans.
Can you tell me any other demographical information?
Yes, as of 2010 Colorado has the 7th highest percentage and 5th largest population of Hispanics.
That is interesting, can you tell me a little bit about the history?
After World War II two ships were named in honor of the state, which includes the battleship USS Colorado who served in the war in 1941.
Can you tell me a little more?
During the attack of Pearl Harbor the USS Colorado was located at the naval base in San Diego, California.
Thank you for all the information today!
You are welcome! Good-bye for now.
Hello, please tell me some information on Saint Helena
OK. It was an important port of call for the East India Company.
Okay, do you have information on the geography of Saint Helena?
I do not but can tell you the area was named for Saint Helena of Constantinople.
Sounds good, do you have information on the media and communications of Saint Helena, please?
The government funded a new 3-channel FM service run by the South Atlantic Media Services.
Interesting! Is there more?
They offer tv for the island via 17 analogue channels that offer a mix of British, US and South African programming.
Very cool! Do you have more on this topic?
Besides a weekly tv news broadcast, there is a weekly newspaper, The Sentinel.
Always a prestigious name! Did you come across anything on the geography yet?
I can tell you that St Helena is an island situated in the Western Hemisphere and has the same longitude as Cornwall in the UK.
Very interesting! Is there any more on the geography?
Much of the island is covered by New Zealand flax, a former industry plant.
Thank you very much, this information is very helpful!
You are welcome!

messages.message: Hello, I am looking to find out more about Ontario please
Hi, the official language of Ontario is English.
Okay, is there any other basic information you can tell me about Ontario?
In 1927 prohibition in Ontario was ended. This was due to the creation of the Liquor Control Board of Ontario the government lead by Howard Ferguson.
Can you tell me where Ontario is located what is the capital of its location? Things like that
Toronto is the Capital of Ontario.
Okay, can you tell me about the transportation in Ontario?
Transportation routes were created by First Nations paths, which were followed by European explorers and from early waterway travel.
Do you know the means of transportation there in Ontario and if they have a major airport
Ontario's airport is Ottawa Macdonald-Cartier International Airport and its the 2nd largest airport.
I am looking for some History on Ontario
Most of Ontario was considered part of New France until 1763. This claim was made by the French.\
That is all I need for today
OK thank you.
Where is Nigeria?
Nigeria is a country in west Africa.
Could you tell me about the economy in Nigeria?
Sure, in 2018 Nigeria announced a new National Carrier after the previous one was shut down for 15 years.
What is a National carrier?
I don't have that information, but I see that Nigeria is the 50th largest export market for US goods.
Could you tell me about the Etymology of Nigeria?

I'm sorry, I don't have any information on the etymology. Something interesting about their history is that they regained democracy in 1999 after electing the former military head of state as the President.
What type of animals are in Nigeria?
I'm sorry, I don't have that information. Something I found interesting is that Nigeria was the first African country to completely pay off all of their debt in 2006.
Oh wow that's really interesting. What else can you tell me about Nigeria?
The United States is Nigeria's largest foreign investor.
That is something I didn't know thank you.
You're very welcome! Is there anything else I can help you with?
No you have helped me a lot.
Glad I could help! Have a great day!
Hello do you know anything about Aruba?
Hello. Yes, Aruba is an island in the Caribbean Sea.
I knew that much but I don't really know specific things about the island. What is their culture like?
Well, the holiday of Carnaval is an important one in Aruba, just like in many Carribean countries; just like Mardi Gras, it goes on for weeks.
I love to party sounds like Carnaval is the right place to be for partiers. Have any government facts I should know about?
Aruba is one of four countries that make of the Kingdom of the Netherlands. The islands hopes to gain independence by 1996 stopped in 1990 by the request of the island people.
Well I have to run but I'd like one more government factoid please.
Okay, and absolutely. As a member of the Kingdom of the Netherlands, along with Aruba, all countries share the Dutch nationality.
Wow did not know that. Thanks have to run.
It was a pleasure talking to you.
Same to you. Goodbye!
Bye!
Hello! Can you tell me about the laws in the United Arab Emirates?
The annual Freedom House report on Freedom in the World has listed the United Arab Emirates as " Not Free " every year since 1999 , the first year for which records are available on their website.
That's interesting. Can you tell me more about it?
Freedom House measures civil liberties and political rights. The UAE also ranks poorly in the annual reporters without borders press freedom index.
Alright, so what about the United Arab Emirates' geography? Can you tell me a little about that?

The UAE is a country in western Asia at the southeast end of the Arabian peninsula on the Persian gulf, bordering Omen to the east is Saudi Arabia to the South, as well as sharing Maritime borders with Qatar to the west and I ran to the north.
Fascinating! Can you share any other interesting facts about the United Arab Emirates?

Amputation is a legal punishment in the UAE due to the Sharia courts. in February an Indonesian woman convicted of adultery by the Sharia Court in the emirate of fujairah, was sentenced to death by stoning after she purportedly insisted on such punishment.
Oh, wow! That's scary! Can you tell me more about the Sharia Court?
In June 1998 , the Shari'a court in Fujairah sentenced three Omani nationals convicted of robbery to have their right hands amputated .
That's terrifying! Thank you for all of the information.
You're welcome!
I'm looking for information about East Timor.

East Timor or Timor Leste is a country in Southeast Asia. East Timor was colonized by Portugal in the 16th century and was known as Portuguese Timor until 28 November 1975, when the Revolutionary Front for an Independent East Timor ( Fretilin ) declared the territory 's independence. After declaration of East Timor 's nationhood in 1999 , the terms of the Timor Gap Treaty were abandoned and negotiations commenced between Australia and East Timor , culminating in the Timor Sea Treaty
Is East Timor known for anything specific?

I'm sorry, I don't have that information but I can tell you that since the discovery of petroleum in the Timor Sea in the 1970s , there have been disputes surrounding the rights to ownership and exploitation of the resources situated in a part of the Timor Sea known as the Timor Gap , which is the area of the Timor Sea which lies outside the territorial boundaries of the nations to the north and south of the Timor Sea .
I'd like to know more about East Timor's military and relations around the world.

The East Timor Defence Force ( Forças de Defesa de Timor-Leste , F-FDTL ) is the military body responsible for the defence of East Timor The East Timor Defence Force ( Forças de Defesa de Timor-Leste , F-FDTL ) is the military body responsible for the defence of East Timor .
What is life like for the people in East Timor?
I'm sorry, that information if not available but did you know that East Timor 's two official languages are Portuguese and Tetum.
That is interesting. Are there any more cultural facts you can share?

Due to the East and West combination of East Timor 's cuisine, it developed features related to Filipino cuisine, which also experienced an East-West culinary combination. Sports organizations joined by East Timor include the International Olympic Committee ( IOC ) , the International Association of Athletics Federations ( IAAF ) , the International Badminton Federation ( IBF ) , the Union Cycliste Internationale , the International Weightlifting Federation , the International Table Tennis Federation ( ITTF ) , the International Basketball Federation ( FIBA ) , and East Timor 's national football team joined FIFA .
Very interesting. Thank you for the information.
Your welcome.

The government regards Taiwan as an independent, sovereign state and as synonymous with the Republic of China and seeks to eventually formally declare Taiwan as independent.

I am not sure if Taiwan is a democracy but I do know that the tension between China and Taiwan shades most of the political life because the policy of the PRC is combat Taiwanese independence.

Well, the People's Republic of China (PRC) claims that the Republic of China government is illegitimate. They say that Taiwan and mainland China are both part of China and that they are the only legitimate government of both.
I understand the tension between the countries now. Does Taiwan have a military to defend itself from PRC?
The current Republic of China military doctrine says to hold out against an invasion or blockade until the US military responds.
Does Taiwan have a military relation ship with the US?
Yea, in the past, France and the Netherlands also tried to give arms to the ROC military forces but soon stopped due to the PRC.
Has the PRC ever tried to invade or threaten the Republic of China/Taiwan in the past? What kind of disputes do they have that would call for military action?
Sorry, I do not have that specific information.
I understand. Well, thank you for teaching me about Taiwain/Republic of China. Have a nice day!
No problem, it was a pleasure!
Can you tell me about Colorado Springs, Colorado?
Sure! Colorado Springs is the largest city by area in CO as well as the county seat. It is a home rule municipality.
What do you know its education?
One educational institution in Colorado Springs is Pikes Peak Community College. It offers a two-year degree program.
I've never heard of it. Are there any universities?
Yes. The University of Colorado Colorado Springs is located there, as well as Colorado Technical University. They were established between 1965 and 1968.
Nice to know. Can you tell me about its sister cities?
Fujiyoshida, Yamanashi, located in Japan, was its first sister city.
Wow, that is interesting. Do you know when that happened?
Unfortunately I don't have a date for that. I can tell you that the Colorado Springs City Hall was constructed between 1902 and 1904, on land donated by W. S. Stratton.
That's fine. You've provided me with great information. Thank you.
You're welcome! Happy to help.
Can you please tell me about the demographics of North America?
Sure! North America has a population of 527 millions people and is the 4th most populous continent in the world.
Interesting! What else can you tell me about demographics?
The country with the most people in North America is the United States with an estimated 330 million people. The most dominant languages spoken in North America are English, French, and Spanish.
Nice! Would you have any information on the name or how North America got named?
I don't have the information, I'm sorry. I can tell you that the West Indies, or the Caribbean Islands, are considered a part of North America.
That's good information. Are there any other facts you can tell me about North America?
A study in 2015 estimated that about 493,000 Christians come from a Muslim background and most of them belong to some form of Protestantism.
Great! That is all the information I need. Thank you!
It was my pleasure!

Beijing became the first city in China to require the Chinese equivalent to the Euro 4 emission standard.

600 million people were impacted when smog stuck Beijing and North China.

China is known for its extreme smog because Beijing is the worlds most populous capital city.

One of the 7 national military headquarters is based in Beijing and is called the Beijing Military Region.

You're welcome is there any other questions I can answer?
Can you tell me where Kaziranga National Park is located

Sure, Kaziranga National Park is a national park in India. The park is home to two-thirds of the world's great one-horned rhinoceroses. It is a World Heritage Site. Kaziranga National Park has been granted maximum protection under the Indian law for wildlife conservation. During the peak months of July and August , three-fourths of the western region of the park is submerged , due to the rising water level of the Brahmaputra.
Do you know what other animals are located there

Yes, Kaziranga is home to large breeding populations of tigers, elephants, wild water buffalo, and swamp deer. One type of swamp deer now only exists in the park. Kaziranga National Park ( pronounced kaziɹɔŋa ɹast ( ɹ ) iɔ uɪddan ) is a national park in the Golaghat and Nagaon districts of the state of Assam, India.
That is very interesting. Do you know where the land animals migrate to during the months of July and August when the area is flooded?

I'm sorry I don't have that information. but I can tell you that During the peak months of July and August , three-fourths of the western region of the park is submerged , due to the rising water level of the Brahmaputra .
Do you know about the language spoke in the area

I'm sorry, that information is not available. Did you know that Kaziranga is a vast expanse of tall elephant grass, marshland, and dense tropical moist broadleaf forests, crisscrossed by four major rivers, including the Brahmaputra, and the park includes numerous small bodies of water?
That is interesting. You know a lot of facts. What else do you think may be helpful to me

Among the Karbis, Kajir is a common name for a girl child, and it was believed that a woman named Kajir once ruled over the area. According to one legend , a girl named Rawnga , from a nearby village , and a youth named Kazi , from Karbi Anglong , fell in love . The history of Kaziranga as a protected area can be traced back to 1904 , when Mary Curzon , Baroness Curzon of Kedleston , the wife of the Viceroy of India , Lord Curzon of Kedleston , visited the area .
That is a nice story. I like legends. Thank you for teaching me. bye

Madurai has been inhabited since at least the third century BCE.

Certainly, there are direct trains that connect Madurai with major cities and towns across india.
That's interesting. Is there anything else you can tell me about Madurai?
Madurai Junction is the major railway station servinf the city.

Guatemala has the largest economy in Central America. They have free trade agreements with Taiwan and Colombia.
Wow, what else can you tell me about that?
In 2006 they also ratified the Dominican Republic's Central American Free Trade Agreement between many of the countries in Central America and the United States.
I didn't know that. What can you tell me about the government?
Legislative power is part of both the government and the Congress of the Republic.
Any other info?
The former president resigned in 2015 a day after the Congress impeached him.

It was due to a corruption scandal and Otto Perez Molina was replaced by Alejandro Maldonado. There was proof that Molina was one the leaders of La Linea.
