La Linea is a cartel gang that traffics drugs among other things.
Wow, I didn't know that!
You are welcome!
Can you tell me more about Comoros?
Comoros is a small island nation in the Indian Ocean. Would you like to know more about its geography?
Sure, tell me more about it's Geography?
The Capital and largest city in Comoros is Moroni.
I see, tell me more about Moroni?
There are two types of marriages there. The Mna dabo (little marriage) and the ada (grand marriage).
Im assuming little marriage means small wedding, what can you tell me about Comoros culture?
Lineage membership and inheritance of immovable goods (like land and housing) are matrilineal, which means passed in the maternal line.
Tell me more about the culture.
I don't have that information on hand. What I can tell you is that half the population lives below the international poverty line of U.S. 1.25 a day.
That is sad, what can you tell me about the economy?
I don't have that information at this time. What I can tell you is that the religion of the majority of the population is Sunni Islam.
I didn't know that, well thank you for all the information, it was very interesting. That is all that i would like to know for today.

I have lots of information for you. Andorra is a European country between Spain and France. About 84K people live in the country. During the Spanish Civil War the inhabitants of Andorra welcomed refugees from both sides and many of them settled permanently in the country thus contributing to the subsequent economic boom and the entry into the capitalist era.
I understand that they have many courts in this country. Can you tell me more about that?

I have that information. But Andorra Officially the Principality of Andorra also called the Principality of the Valleys of Andorra is a sovereign landlocked microstate on the Iberian Peninsula, in eastern Pyrenees.
They have a lot of valleys and mountains, right?

They do, and due to its location in the eastern Pyrenees mountain range, Andorra consists predominantly of rugged mountains, the highest being the Coma Pedrosa at 2942m, and the average elevation of Andorra is 1996m.
what is the history of Andorra? I really don't know much about this country.
Andorra declared war on Imperial Germany during World War I, but did not take part directly in the fighting. With the passage of time, the co-title to Andorra passed to the kings of Navarre.
Interesting! How long has Andorra been around? I don't think a lot of people even know it exists!
I do not have the exact date, but given its relative isolation, Andorra has existed outside the mainstream of European history with few ties to countries other than France, Spain and Portugal.
Any idea what language(s) they speak there?
That information is available to me, but Andorra is not a member of the European Union, but the euro is its official currency.

I did not know that. Do you know the biggest contributor to the economy?

It's population is 5.1 Million.

Cricket is one of the most popular sports in the city. In 1982 Sadar Patel stadium was built.
What other sports are there?
Sorry I don't know about that, But I can tell you about how Ahmedabad is know for its textiles and clothes.

Ahmedabad is called the Manchester of the East because of its large exports of clothing.
Okay, what can I learn about their international relations?
After a heatwave in May 2010 caused the deaths of hundreds the Amedabad Municipal Corporation worked with the International coalition of health to develop the Amedabad Heat Action plan.

North America is the third largest continent. Only Asia and Africa are bigger.

The geology of Hawaii consist of Neogene volcanics that erupted over a hot spot. While Alaska is typical of the cordillera.

oh ok. Can you tell me about the climatic conditions

oh great! can you tell me more about the Geology of teh place

You are welcome.

Also known as the Union of Comoros, is a small island nation in the Indian Ocean.
Please tell me more.
The French were the first to rule back in 1841.
The French were the first to rule? That is interesting. Do the French still occupy Comoros?
Most of the French left after their independence in 1975.

The local women wear a colorful sari-like dress called a Shiromani, and apply a paste of ground sandalwood and coral to their faces.

Before independence, they were under the province of Madagascar starting in 1912.
So were they a province of Madagascar until their independence in 1975?
They were the protector of the island.
Okay, thank you!
your welcome

On June 5,1998. East Timor was taken over by the UN.

On May 20,2002 the constitution of the Democratic Republic of East Timor came into power. Causing East Timor to be recognized as Independent by the UN.

The Northern Territory is also the home of two natural rock formations, Ayers Rock & The Olgas. Both are sacred to the local Aboriginal peoples and major tourist attractions.
Can you tell me more about the Geography of this area?

In addition to the two spectacular rock formations mentioned earlier, the territory has large areas of dessert. Many archaeological sites, rock carvings & cave paintings can be found in the Northern Territory. In addition, Kakadu National Park is a World Heritage area.
That is very interesting. I enjoy archeology very much. What can you tell me about the people of the Northern Territory?

Indigenous Australians have lived in the Northern Territory for approximately 40,000 years. Extensive trade was established, for at least five centuries, between the indigenous Australians & the peoples of what is now Indonesia. Over 100 Aboriginal languages & dialects are spoken in the Northern Territory, in addition to English.
Wow! That is a lot of languages. What is the education system like?

State or government schools, also known as public schools, are funded & run by the Department of Education. Batchelor Institute of Indigenous Tertiary Education was the first tertiary institution in the Northern Territory & was founded in the mid-1960's. Charles Darwin University has about 19,000 enrolled students. Of that number, 5500 are higher education students & the remainder are vocational education students.

In 2015, President Ram Baran Yadav announced the new Constitution.

Thanks for the info

YEs during the age of discovery, Europeans explored and staked various claims to parts of North America.
Do you know anything specifically about those explorers?

Not specifically, but I do know that a long time ago, during the Late Paleozoic to Early Mesozoic eras, North America was joined with other modern-day continents as part of the super continent "Pangaea."

Northern America and western United States share a cowboy culture.

Canada and the U.S. were both former British colonies.

Hello, can you tell me about Aruba?

interesting, What are some other places of interest in Aruba

Aruba was colonized by Spain for over a century.

Hello what can you tell me about the climate in the Northern Territory?

Hello. The climate in the Northern Territory of Australia's northern side has a tropical climate distinguished with high humidity and two seasons, the wet and dry seasons. From October to April is the wet season, and from May to September is the dry season.
What else can you tell me about the climate?
Sorry, I don't have more information on that. I can tell you that the territory only has one daily tabloid newspaper, which is News Corporation's Northern Territory News (NT News).
what can you tell me about the economy?

Mining is a large part of its economy. The main mining operation areas include the following: bauxite at Gove Peninsula; manganese at Groote Eylandt, Bootu Creek, and Frances Creek; gold at the Union Reefs plant; and uranium at Ranger Uranium Mine. The production of bauxite was estimated at $254 million in 2007-2008, manganese production was estimated at $1.1 billion, and gold was estimated at $672 million.
interesting what else can you tell me?
Its economy today is largely based on the aforementioned mining, as well as tourism, especially the Kakadu National Park and the Uluru-Kata Tjuta National Park (Ayers Rock).
wow what other interesting facts can you tell me?

Many areas of the territory have Aboriginal communities. The biggest ones are the Pitjantjatjara near Uluru, the Luritja between Uluru and Alice Springs, the Arrernte near Alice Springs, the Warlpiri to the north, and the Yolngu in eastern Arnhem Land.
Thank you so much for all of your help
You're welcome. Have a great day.

Well, I am shocked! I did not know it was in Canada! Wow! Let's see... What can you tell me about the military bases there?
I do not have information on the military. Can I interest you in something else?

In the 17th century when European traders arrived, the economy became centered on beaver pelts and other furs.
Beaver pelts? Interesting. What is the economy centered on now?
The economy became more diversified after Lord Selkirk brought farmers to the area in 1811.
I bet they had more options for buying, selling and trading? Who is Lord Selkirk?
I can tell you that Lord Selkirk was the first to establish agricultural communities and settlements in 1812. This also led to a conflict between the British colonist and the Metis.
Wonder why that bothered the British so much? Do you know anything else about the economy with Lord Selkirk? He is quite interesting.
I am not sure, but I can tell you that agriculture is important to the economy there. Most farming occurs in the Southern half of Manitoba.
Wow! I have learned so much today! I thank you for your time!
You are welcome!

The city of Colorado Springs had a new system of government in 2011.

Colorado Springs and Denver hosted the 1962 NHL, the World Ice Hockey Championships.

The Mountain West Conference and the National Collegiate Hockey Conference are both in Colorado Springs.
What are some other cities that are nearby.

I apologize I do not have that information other then Denver. You might be interested to know that Colorado Springs in considered to be the 34th most walk able cities in the the fifty states in the US.

The Tori gate, crisscrossed bridge and shrine, Located in the median between Platt and Bijou Streets in Colorado Springs was erected in 1966 by the rotary club making them the Twin Cities.
That's very interesting. Thank you for all your help.
You are Very Welcome!! :-)

It has numerous museums, the greatest concentration of these are in Chicago.

Many minor league teams also call Illinois their home.

Illinois played an important role in the early Later Day Saint movement, with Nauvoo, Illinois, becoming a gathering place for Mormons in the early 1840s

As a state in the United States, its capital is Springfield. It's largest city is Chicago!

In 2016, venture capitalists from Illinois funded a total of approximately $62 billion into the U.S. economy.

St. Kitts has a tropical savanna climate but Nevis has a tropical monsoon climate!

St. Kitts was given a name by Christopher Columbus, but there is disagreement over the name which he gave!

More on etymology: There are new studies now that suggest that Columbus actually named one of the islands Sant Yago!

The river Sabarmati goes through Ahmedabad and it's known for its textiles.

With a population of about 10 million , Hungary is a Central European country.

The early founded historical association with the Huns , who settled Hungary prior to the Avars is considered the reason for "H" in the name of Hungary.

The collective name of the tribes who later joined the Bulgar tribal confederacy that ruled the eastern parts of Hungary after the Avars was Onogur.

Relatively low for EU states, Hungary's corporate tax rate is only 9%.

the federation of nigeria gained independence from the uk on 1 october 1960, while retaining the british monarch, elizabeth ii, as nominal head of state & queen of nigeria

administratively, Nigeria remained divided into the northern and southern protectorates and lagos colony

a significant shia minority exists

messages.message: Hi! I am looking to find information on Marshall Islands. What are you able to tell me about their culture?
The Marshallese used the stars and stick-and-shell charts to navigate. They were very skilled in this area.
I did not know they had such skills! What other cool culture facts do you have?
As a population they are very family and faith oriented. About 10% of the population has migrated to Arkansas, they bring with them the dance and music of the islands.
That is interesting information. What else do you have on culture?

That is all I have with regards to culture. But you may find this interesting, Almost the entire population practice religion. About three quarters of the country follow the UCCMI, which stands for United Church of Christ-Congressional of the Marshall Islands.
Do you have any other demographic information for Mashall Islands?
The Capital, Majuro accounts for about one-quarter of the population. Ebeye also accounts for another one-quarter of the population.
Thanks for that. Do you have more information on demographics?
A small community of Ahmadiyya Muslin reside in Majuro. In 2012 the first mosque opened in Majuro.
Thanks again for the information. That will be all for now.
You are quite welcome.
Hey! Tell me about African Union.

Sure! The African Union is an international organization consisting of fifty-five African member countries. Founded in Durban on July 9, 2002, the AU was formed as a replacement to the Organization of African Unity and the African Economic Community.
Can you please tell me about their politics?

Yes. The 1980 Lagos Plan of Action for the Development of Africa and the 1991 treaty to establish the African Economic Community (also referred to as the Abuja Treaty) proposed the creation of Regional Economic Communities as the basis for African integration, with a timetable for regional and then continental integration to follow.
Do you have any other info about their politics?

Yes, The current Chairperson of the African Union is President of Rwanda Paul Kagame since January 28, 2018. the AU, in the future, aims to have a single currency and a single integrated defense force, as well as other institutions of state, including a cabinet for the AU Head of State.
I am curious about their economy, do you have information to share about that?
Unfortunately not but I can tell you that in regards to current issues in June of 2006, the United States Congress appropriated 173 million U.S. dollars for the AU force.
Do you have any other facts about the African Union?

An important fact is that the purpose of the AU organization is to help secure the continent's democracy, human rights, and a sustainable economy, especially by bringing an end to conflict between African nations and creating an effective common market.
You have been so helpful. Thank you very much.
Glad to help!
Hello! Can you tell me about the history of Ahmedabad?
Yes, Ahmedabad is a big city in West India. It is the largest city in the Indian state of Gujarat and the seventh-largest city in India.
What can you tell me about its history?

The following year, a three-day period of violence between Hindus and Muslims in the western Indian state of Gujarat, known as the 2002 Gujarat riots, spread to Ahmedabad, refugee camps were set up around the city.

Recently Ahmedabad hosted national level games for roller skating and table tennis. Yes, Cricket is one of the popular sports in the city.

Many Countries sought to emulate India's economic planning strategy and one of them, South Korea, copied the city's second "Five-Year-Plan"
Thanks for all the information today?

Tell me what you know about Beijing.
Beijing was once know as Peking, and it the capital of China. It has the largest population of any city in the world. Is there a specific topic you'd like to learn more about?
Let's start with their culture first-if that's possible.

Native people of Beijing speak Beijing dialect, which belongs to the Mandarin division of the Chinese language. Opera is very popular in China, and Beijing is well known for its operatic productions. Beijing opera is performed in an archaic dialect quite different from modern Chinese or Beijing dialect.
Go on, you've got my full attention.

Built in 1605, the Cathedral of the Immaculate Conception is the oldest Catholic Church in Beijing. The oldest mosque in Beijing is the Niujie Mosque. It has a history that stretches back over 1000 years. In addition to its operatic productions, Beijing is know for its museums. In addition to the Palace Museum in the Forbidden City and the National Museum of China, Beijing is home to 6 other major museums.
Interesting, love what you're giving me. Feel free to share some more.

Beijing actually has 70 mosques within the city, the Islamic Association of China is headquartered in the city. The Beijing Milu Parks is just south of the city is is home to the largest herds of Pere David's deer, which are now extinct in the wild, unfortunately. Beijing is also home to the Beijing Ancient Observatory, which displays pre-telescopic spheres dating back to the Ming & Qing dynasties.
That's all well and dandy. Do you know about their nature and wildlife as well?

Yes, I do have some information on that topic. Several species are protected by the Beijing Aquatic Wildlife Rescue & Conservation Center, including the Chinese salamander and the Amur stickleback & mandarin duck. In addition over 1000 rescued birds are also protected by the center & are being repatriated into the wild. The species include streptopelia, Eurasian siskin & crested myna to name only a few.
Tell me more, I'm all ears.

Sticking with nature & wildlife, the city's trees include the Chinese arborvitae, which is an evergreen in the cypress family and the Pagoda tree, also called the Chinese scholar tree. The Pagoda tree is a deciduous tree of the Fabaceae family. The flowers of the city include the Chinese rose & chrysanthemum.
I would love to go on, but I believe I'll have to be content with this for now. Thank you once more.
It's been a pleasure! Have a great day.
I would like to know more about the culture of the African Union.
Here's a little culture on the African Union. The African Union Commission had a competition for the selection of a new flag for the African Union.
When was this?

Sorry I don't have that information. I can tell you that during the 14th Ordinary Session of the Assembly of Heads of State and Government the African Union adopted a new flag which took place in Addis Ababa 2010.
Okay thanks! I am also curious about their geography.
The African Union have a wildly diverse geography with the largest hot desert, huge jungles and savannas, and the worlds longest river.

The Sahara desert and the Nile river.
Thanks. What is the wildlife like?
Sorry I don't have that information. I can tell you that they have territory off the mainland. The island of Madagascar which is the fourth largest island and the Sinai peninsula.
Okay. Thanks for the information!
You're welcome.

The US has been wary of South Korea's growing nuclear program, which South Korea insists will only be for civilian use.

South Korea is the EU's 10th largest trading partner, and the EU has become South Korea's 4th largest export destination.

After WWII, the People's Republic of China embraced Maoism while South Korea sought close relations with the United States.

South Korea is the second-largest missionary-sending nation, after the US.
Whoa! Now that IS interesting, I didn't know that. Thanks for your help today!

Armenia is a country in the South Caucasus region of Eurasia. It is in Eastern Europe on the Armenian Highlands, Armenia is bordered by Turkey to the west and Georgia to the North.

Since the early 16th century, both Western Armenia and Eastern Armenia fell to Safavid empire.
Do you know if Turkey has ever admitted to the Armenian Genocide?

Turkey has a long history of poor relations with Armenia over its refusal to acknowledge the Armenia Genocide, even though it was one of the first countries to recognize the republic of Armenia after its independence in 1991

Armenia has engaged in a mission of peacekeeping in Kosovo as part of non-NATO KFOR troops under Greek command.

The current constitution of Armenia states, the President is the head of state holding largely representational functions, while the Prime Minister is the head of the government and excercises executive power.

My pleasure

Compared to other protected areas in India, this park has notable protection by its management!

There are also snakes slithering around, like the Indian cobra, monocled cobra, the Russell's viper, and the common krait..

On August 3, 2016 the park was fllooded 70%.

Nigerian cinema is Africa's largest movie industry when it comes to value and the amount of movies produced per year.

Yes, China supports a version of the One-China policy, which states that Taiwan and mainland China are both part of China, and that China is the only legitimate government of China.
That is interesting. So the Chinese government has control of Taiwan?
Sorry I have no facts on that, however regarding legal status China claims the Taiwan government is illegitimate.

During the 1950's and 1960's, after the government had withdrawn to Taiwan upon losing the Chinese Civil War, it was commonly referred to as Nationalist China, to differentiate it from Communist China.

There is no direct information on that. However, since the government launched a policy promoting Chinese caligraphy, painting, and Chinese opera one might assume that is the case.

The demographics please.
It is the world's most populous capital city. In 2017 the Chinese government implemented population controls for Beijing and Shanghai.

According to the 2010 census, nearly 96% of Beijing's population are ethnic Han Chinese.

Beijing's Nominal GDP per capita ranked 1st in the country.
Know any more?

The country's financial regulatory agencies including the central bank, bank regulator, securities regulator, and foreign exchange authority are located in the neighborhood: Beijing Central Business District.

Foreign visitors are not permitted to leave Beijing for other Chinese cities for the first 72 hours.
